page_label: 说　明　书 6/17 页

paragraphs.zh: 4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯(98％，0.1mol)倒入釜中进行碱解反应，反应过程微微放热，控制釜温为25℃，反应7h。反应结束，液相色谱中控2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钠盐归一含量为98.2％，负压脱尽溶剂直接用于后续醚化反应。
paragraphs.en: ...4-methylsulfonylbenzoate (98%, 0.1mol) was poured into the reactor to carry out the alkaline hydrolysis reaction. The reaction was slightly exothermic; the reactor temperature was controlled at 25 C and the reaction was run for 7h. After the reaction was complete, in-process liquid chromatography gave a normalised content of sodium 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate of 98.2%; the solvent was stripped off completely under reduced pressure and the material was used directly in the subsequent etherification reaction.
paragraphs.notes: Unmarked block at the top of the page: this is the tail of a paragraph that begins on the preceding page (p08). It starts mid-chemical-name, the printed fragment beginning at '4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯', so the full name of the charged material is not resolvable from this page alone. By the parallel wording of [0075] on this same page the full name is almost certainly methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, but that is inference from the sibling paragraph, not from this page's own text.

paragraphs.zh: (2)2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的制备，主要反应过程可以以如下反应方程式表示：
paragraphs.en: (2) Preparation of 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid. The main reaction process can be represented by the following reaction equation:
paragraphs.notes: The Chinese name places the parenthesis as '3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基', translated literally here as '3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl'. The drawing at [0069] shows the group attached to the ring as CH2-O-CH2CF3, i.e. a (2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl substituent.
Marker carries no prose. It labels the reaction scheme drawn to its right; see drawings[0].

paragraphs.zh: 向反应釜中加入50mL三氟乙醇，开动搅拌，室温下投入5.2g氢化钠(60％，0.13mol)，搅拌至溶解完全，经脱溶后得到三氟乙醇醇钠固体，密封备用。
paragraphs.en: 50mL of trifluoroethanol was added to the reactor, stirring was started, and 5.2g of sodium hydride (60%, 0.13mol) was charged at room temperature. The mixture was stirred until dissolution was complete, and after removal of solvent the solid sodium trifluoroethoxide was obtained and sealed for later use.
paragraphs.notes: 氢化钠 is sodium hydride; a 60% assay is the usual specification for the mineral-oil dispersion. Transcribed literally without comment on whether the stated percentage and mol figures are self-consistent.

paragraphs.zh: 向三氟乙醇醇钠中加入200mL THF，搅拌溶解后控制釜温在5℃，将步骤(1)制备得到的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钠盐(98.2％，0.1mol)分八次加入反应瓶中，总加料时间为3h，加毕保温反应3h。反应完毕，负压脱溶，釜残加水120mL，搅拌溶解后滴加浓盐酸将体系pH值酸化至2，之后经过滤、水淋洗、烘干得到产物32.9g，HPLC定量得目标化合物2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸含量为98.7％，以2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯计两步反应收率93.8％。
paragraphs.en: 200mL of THF was added to the sodium trifluoroethoxide; after stirring to dissolve, the reactor temperature was controlled at 5 C, and the sodium 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate prepared in step (1) (98.2%, 0.1mol) was added to the reaction flask in eight portions, with a total charging time of 3h; after charging was finished the reaction was held at temperature for 3h. When the reaction was complete the solvent was stripped under reduced pressure, 120mL of water was added to the reactor residue, and after stirring to dissolve, concentrated hydrochloric acid was added dropwise to acidify the system to pH 2. Filtration, water rinsing and drying then gave 32.9g of product; HPLC assay gave a content of the target compound 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid of 98.7%, and a two-step yield of 93.8% based on methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate.
paragraphs.notes: '釜残' rendered as 'reactor residue'. The 93.8% is stated as the yield over both steps, counted from the methyl ester, not from the sodium salt charged in this step.

paragraphs.zh: (1)2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐的制备，主要反应过程可以以如下反应方程式表示：
paragraphs.en: (1) Preparation of the 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate salt. The main reaction process can be represented by the following reaction equation:
paragraphs.notes: The heading says only 苯甲酸盐 (the benzoate salt), without naming the counter-ion; the drawing at [0074] and the body text at [0075] both make it the sodium salt. Translated literally rather than promoted to 'sodium benzoate'.
Marker carries no prose. It labels the reaction scheme drawn to its right; see drawings[1].

paragraphs.zh: 向反应瓶中加入叔戊醇200mL，开动搅拌，室温下将8.8g氢氧化钠(48％，0.105mol)滴入其中，待氢氧化钠分散均匀后，控制釜温在25℃，将34.8g 2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯(98％，0.1mol)倒入釜中进行碱解反应，反应过程微微放热，控制釜温为25℃，反应7h。反应结束，液相色谱中控2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钠盐归一含量为97.8％，负压脱尽溶剂直接用于后续醚化反应。
paragraphs.en: 200mL of tert-amyl alcohol was added to the reaction flask and stirring was started; at room temperature 8.8g of sodium hydroxide (48%, 0.105mol) was added dropwise into it, and once the sodium hydroxide was uniformly dispersed the reactor temperature was controlled at 25 C, and 34.8g of methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate (98%, 0.1mol) was poured into the reactor to carry out the alkaline hydrolysis reaction. The reaction was slightly exothermic; the reactor temperature was controlled at 25 C and the reaction was run for 7h. After the reaction was complete, in-process liquid chromatography gave a normalised content of sodium 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate of 97.8%; the solvent was stripped off completely under reduced pressure and the material was used directly in the subsequent etherification reaction.
paragraphs.notes: 叔戊醇 translated as tert-amyl alcohol (2-methyl-2-butanol). The 48% figure is the aqueous sodium hydroxide strength, so the 8.8g is charged as a solution, which is why the text says 滴入 (added dropwise).

paragraphs.zh: (2)2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的制备，主要反应过程可以以如下反应方程式表示：
paragraphs.en: (2) Preparation of 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid. The main reaction process can be represented by the following reaction equation:

paragraphs.notes: Marker carries no prose. It labels the reaction scheme drawn to its right; see drawings[2].

paragraphs.zh: 向反应釜中加入50mL三氟乙醇，开动搅拌，室温下投入2.8g金属钠(99％，0.12mol)，搅拌至溶解完全，经脱溶后得到三氟乙醇醇钠固体，密封备用。
paragraphs.en: 50mL of trifluoroethanol was added to the reactor, stirring was started, and 2.8g of metallic sodium (99%, 0.12mol) was charged at room temperature. The mixture was stirred until dissolution was complete, and after removal of solvent the solid sodium trifluoroethoxide was obtained and sealed for later use.
paragraphs.notes: Differs from [0070] in the base: metallic sodium here, sodium hydride there.

paragraphs.zh: 向三氟乙醇醇钠中加入70mL DMSO，搅拌溶解后控制釜温在-5℃，将步骤(1)制备
paragraphs.en: 70mL of DMSO was added to the sodium trifluoroethoxide; after stirring to dissolve, the reactor temperature was controlled at -5 C, and [the material] prepared in step (1) [was ...]
paragraphs.notes: Paragraph is cut off at the foot of the page after 制备; it continues on the following page (p10). The sentence is incomplete as printed here.

substituents: C(=O)O-Na (sodium carboxylate, drawn as NaO-C(=O)-) at C1
structures.name: sodium 3-(bromomethyl)-2-chloro-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate

drawings.notes: Positions are read off the drawing: the ring vertex bearing the carboxylate is C1 at the left; going clockwise from it, Cl sits on the adjacent top vertex, the CH2 group on the next vertex to the upper right, and the methanesulfonyl on the vertex below that. On the left-hand structure the sodium is drawn covalently bonded as NaO-C(=O)-, so the SMILES records it that way rather than as a separated ion pair; the prose calls it the 钠盐 (sodium salt). The trifluoroethoxymethyl chain on the right-hand structure is drawn out as CH2 to O to CH2 to CF3, with the terminal group lettered CF3.
